This violates README.md:411 ("Core plugins (Tier 1-2) maintain version synchronization") and docs/PRD/completed/automated-version-management.md:277 (FR-3.7 "Version-locked strategy: All 25 packages maintain same version"). Decide target version (highest 6.0.4? align with ensemble-full 6.9.2?), update all 8 package.json + 8 .claude-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace.json entries + package-lock.json entries, refresh CHANGELOG, then verify scripts/validate-version-sync.js (if exists) or reconstruct the contract enforcement.
